capacity_policy: A reported, event- or layout-specific number with year and spatial boundary; never inferred from area.
annual_visitation_policy: Square-level operator counts only; distinguish visits, unique people and museum admissions. Missing is null, never zero.
weekday_holiday_policy: Qualitative paired programme comparison unless a matched count series is available. No invented peak multiplier.
population_policy: Municipal/LGA scope, reference date and registry/ERP method stated; metropolitan figures separate.
coverage_policy: Metric union of footprint polygons clipped to a 600m square; denominator includes water; source epoch and semantics retained.
